Tooltip

Hover/focus tooltip wrapping nextjs-components via deep import. Local SCSS styling with geist token overrides.

Props

PropTypeDefaultDescription
textstring—Tooltip content
side"top" | "bottom" | "left" | "right""top"Tooltip position
delaynumber—Show delay in ms
invertbooleanfalseInvert color scheme

Usage

<Tooltip text="Save changes" side="bottom">
  <button>Save</button>
</Tooltip>

<Tooltip text="Delete this item" side="right" delay={500}>
  <Icon name="trash" size="sm" />
</Tooltip>
